Software Engineer Crypto Services**At a glance**
---------------


Are you a **Software Engineer** with a passion for security, cloud\-native technologies, and solving complex technical challenges? Join our **Crypto Services** team and help build and maintain the critical platforms that safeguard our customers, enable secure banking, and protect the bank's digital infrastructure. Whether you're already experienced in cryptography or eager to grow into the field, you'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while making a real impact.

**Your job**
------------


As a Software Engineer, you will be part of an agile DevOps team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining secure, resilient, and high\-performing solutions. You will contribute throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation and operational support.

  

You take ownership of your work, actively contribute ideas, share knowledge with your teammates, and continuously improve both the software and the way of working. Together with your colleagues, you will build high\-quality, maintainable, and future\-proof solutions using modern technologies and platforms, including Microsoft Azure.

  

You will primarily develop secure backend services and APIs supporting key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) integrations. Working closely with security specialists, platform engineers, and product owners, you will help deliver critical security services that are used throughout the bank.

**Working environment**
-----------------------


At ABN AMRO, we believe in creating an open and supportive environment where you can learn, experiment, make mistakes, and celebrate successes. We value feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and we are committed to your professional and personal growth. As part of Platforms \& Technology, the foundation of ABN AMRO's digital landscape, you'll work on meaningful challenges that help shape the future of secure banking. We encourage you to take ownership, seize opportunities, and make an impact.

 **About IT Platforms \& Technology.** Within ABN AMRO, IT Platforms \& Technology (P\&T) provides the foundational platforms and services that enable the bank to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently. This includes our cloud platforms, network infrastructure, data centers, developer platforms, and the tools that support the entire software development lifecycle.

 **About Service Integration \& Orchestration.** The Service Integration \& Orchestration (SI\&O) department plays a key role in ensuring the stability, security, and continuous availability of the bank's IT landscape. Alongside governance and operational responsibilities, SI\&O is home to several DevOps teams that build and operate critical services used across the organization.

 **About Crypto Services.** The Crypto Services team develops and operates the platforms that enable secure banking across ABN AMRO. Our services include key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) solutions that support critical applications and infrastructure throughout the bank.


As part of the Crypto Services team, you will contribute to the platforms that form the foundation of secure banking. From key management and certificate lifecycle management to Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), the services you build and maintain are essential for protecting customers, securing critical business processes, and enabling the bank to operate safely and reliably every day.

**Your profile**
----------------


We're looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions and is eager to grow within the cryptographic domain.

 **What you'll bring**

* Hands\-on experience writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code in Java, C\#, or comparable programming languages, with a strong focus on engineering best practices and code quality.
* Hands\-on experience with Python, particularly in developing, securing, and optimizing APIs.
* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, with a focus on clean architecture and maintainable codebases.
* Ability to analyze, optimize, and improve API performance in distributed systems.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn and grow within the cryptographic domain.

 **Don't tick every box?**

Previous experience in cryptography is not required. We are looking for a software engineer with a solid technical foundation, a security\-minded mindset, and the motivation to learn and grow within the cryptographic domain. **If you're excited about the role but don't meet every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.**

**We are offering**
-------------------


We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.


In addition, we offer:

* An attractive gross monthly salary in Hay 9 based on a 36\-hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget.
* An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
* Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
* Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
* Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
* Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000\.
* An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.


You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.

**Interested?**
---------------


If you believe this role matches your experience and ambitions, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply online. If you'd like to learn more about the team or the role, feel free to contact Patrick Haak (patrick.haak@nl.abnamro.com)

**Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable**
---------------------------------------------------


At ABN AMRO, we believe in "**Banking for better, for generations to come.**" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of **being a personal bank in the digital age** aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future\-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

 *If you want to apply for the B\-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.*

**Disclaimer external recruitment agencies**
--------------------------------------------


External recruitment agencies need to have a signed agreement with ABN AMRO BANK N.V., executed by a Talent Acquisition Specialist, when submitting a resume to a vacancy. In addition, a recruitment agency can only submit a resume when invited by a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join the search for a right candidate. All unsolicited resumes sent to us will be considered property of ABN AMRO BANK N.V. In this case, ABN AMRO will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.

LON000596 Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!


**The Opportunity**


Our risk, security and resilience practice has helped organisations to understand their exposure to threats and make better risk\-informed decisions since it was formed in the mid\-1990s. Our team of experts are trusted advisors to private and public\-sector clients, providing strategic risk management, technical risk assessment, operational planning, security engineering and counter\-terrorism design measures that suit their business needs. Our team apply their knowledge, critical thinking and experience to help our clients to understand and anticipate what could go wrong, and we help with finding better solutions to ensure that risks are effectively managed and controlled. Our team has consistently delivered high\-quality advisory and engineering services to clients across a range of markets and industries, including Rail, Energy, Data Centres, Highways, Healthcare, Property and Scientific research facilities.


You will join Arup as a Consultant working in our protective design engineering team with a focus on sustainable development across a range of market and industries. The types of projects you will be involved range from advisory to engineering solution based blast engineering and hostile vehicle mitigation across a range of project lifecycle stages (such as research \& development, feasibility to concept and detailed design).


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective\- in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning \- to Arup, to your career, to our members, and to the clients and communities we serve.


In this role you will:


* Utilise your knowledge of mainstream structural engineering design practice and develop your understanding of how to model such structures against transient dynamic loading
* Provide technical input across a broad range of projects across the resilience, security and risk practice
* Support the preparation of threat and vulnerability risk assessments for malicious threats (including terrorism, crime and civil disruption)
* Develop coherent, risk\-based security strategies and integrate protective design and/or blast engineering measures from concept through detailed design to construction
* Carry out blast modelling using engineering software including computational fluid dynamic modelling and finite element methods
* Undertake the structural blast engineering design of a wide range of structures in common and novel engineering materials
* Undertake the façade blast engineering design of a wide range of glazed and non\-glazed façade systems
* Undertake the design of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures

**Is this role right for you?**


We are seeking talented structural engineers who have a broad knowledge of structural engineering design and an interest in specialising in resilient structural design, to join our team but possibly to be deployed to projects being led from other centres and to further the development of our blast engineering services globally. Arup has one of the most significant protective design teams globally, with teams in London, Manchester, New York, San Francisco, Melbourne and Singapore working together as one global team.


Unlike traditional codified design, blast engineering requires a very different approach to the design but requires a designer’s empathy with regard to aesthetic, form and function of any proposed facility. As such, this is a great opportunity for an existing practitioner to build their professional and tactical position in the industry, or for a talented structural engineer to provide strategic input and undertake first\-principles design as traditional forms of mainstream structural engineering design are increasingly being automated and undertaken by code\-compliant software.


The successful candidate will be able to confidently and articulately communicate concepts of threat, risk and risk mitigation, supported by our threat specialists, will be able to develop and present conceptual ideas, understand the planning, design and construction process in the development of design solutions in a multi\-disciplinary design environment and will be able to manage the detailed analysis, design and specification of structures and façade subject to blast loads. Furthermore, the role will involve the development of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures as an essential part of protective design strategies. Experience in blast engineering or a related discipline is desirable but not essential.


You will work closely with design team disciplines both within and outside Arup on a regular basis including architecture, SMEP, façade engineering, transport and logistics, civil and highways engineering, fire engineering and computational structural mechanics. The candidate has an opportunity to gain a breadth of experience from a broad range of projects in a range of geographic locations, including opportunities for travel where desired.


You will undertake the blast engineering design of a variety of projects, and will quickly developing both technical and business\-orientated competencies. Our priority is to attract quality staff who have the ability to work in a collaborative, challenging environment, and who show the potential for technical excellence in their field.


The candidate will be based in the Arup London or Manchester offices and travel out of the UK to meet project requirements will be necessary upon occasion.


You will be a Structural Engineer with a strong background in mainstream structural design. You will be working towards chartership with the Institution of Civil Engineers, the Institution of Structural Engineers or an equivalent professional institution. UK Security Clearance (or equivalent in home country) or eligibility to apply for UK Security Clearance is an essential prerequisite. Eligibility requires a background check and usually requires a minimum period of residency in the UK, but is not limited to UK nationals.

  

We're seeking candidates with:


* Masters degree in civil/structural engineering with a strong track record in mainstream structural engineering design
* UK Security Clearance (or equivalent in home country), or eligibility to apply for UK Security Clearance
* Experience in the design of structures in steel, reinforced concrete, timber and/or masonry in accordance with British Standards and Eurocodes
* Experience in the use of a structural analysis software packages
* Coding skills such as Python, JavaScript, C\#
* Ability of using Rhino/Grasshopper
* An understanding of construction methodologies and consideration of buildability issues within the design process
* Knowledge of relevant legislation, regulations, codes of practice and guidelines.

\*\*\*Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application and for the duration of employment. Any offer made will be subject to satisfactory proof of immigration status.\*\*\*


Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact **Marek Mazurowski** (marek.mazurowski@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

  

**What we offer you**

  

  

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.  



  

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.  



  

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.  



  

We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.  



**Different People, Shared Values**


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference.


Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.


We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact **Marek Mazurowski** (marek.mazurowski@arup.com) to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

  

**Our Application Process**


To understand what to expect next, please visit our https://www.arup.com/careers/arup\-careers\-uk\-application\-process.


Stay safe online \- Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.


**Recruitment Agencies** \- We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list


Closing date: 30th October 2026


*We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.*

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.



**Who we are supporting**



The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.



The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:


* Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
* Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
* Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
* Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
* Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.


Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.


**The program**

**Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)**



The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise\-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.



To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance\-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.



### **Software Developer**


### **Role ID – NATOIS\-0049**


**Role Background**



NATO International Staff requires a **Software Developer – Expert Consultant** to support the **Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section**.



The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for **data collection, analysis and visualisation**, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence\-planning data analysis.

* Design, develop and deploy web\-based dashboards.
* Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
* Develop and test data\-collection solutions.
* Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web\-based systems.
* Perform data conversion and preprocessing using **Python APIs and ETL tools**.
* Develop and improve data\-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
* Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
* Support security testing and approval activities.
* Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
* Develop data\-driven dashboards for senior leadership using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
* Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
* Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.


**Essential Skills**


* JavaScript and HTML.
* Modern web development frameworks such as **React, Vue.js or Angular**.
* **MS SQL**.
* **Python** for automation, ETL and data analysis.
* Python libraries including **pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib**.
* Development of data\-driven dashboards using **Python and/or Power BI**.
* Backend services and/or data\-processing pipelines.
* Data integration and preprocessing.
* Git/version control.
* Agile project management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  


**Desirable:**

**Experience**


* Minimum **5 years of web development experience** using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
* Extensive MS SQL experience.
* Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
* Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.


**educations and Certifications**


* **Bachelor's Degree** in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Advanced English.


**Working Location**


**NATO HQ, Brussels, Belgium / Remote**



The contractor has flexibility to work remotely combined with some physical presence at NATO HQ.


**Working Policy**


**Hybrid / flexible remote working with some on\-site presence in Brussels.**



The contractor must be available for contact during approximately half of NATO's official working hours, taking time\-zone differences into account.

Benton is een toonaangevend, multidisciplinair technisch bureau, gespecialiseerd in Engineering\-, Construction\- en Maintenance\-opdrachten. Ben jij een **Projectingenieur HVAC** die warmloopt voor duurzame technieken? Introduction to the job

Are you energized by solving complex engineering challenges in a multidisciplinary team? Do you enjoy applying modern software engineering practices to create solutions that make a difference for customers?

Would you like to contribute to advanced metrology systems and help improve equipment throughput, automation, and integration with customer manufacturing environments?

If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you as a Software Engineer
.

Role and responsibilities

As a Software Engineer, you will develop software for complex machine and algorithm-based solutions. You will take end-to-end ownership of software development in Java and/or C#
, directly contributing to the evolution of metrology solutions.

You will join a team that develops automated data-analysis workflows to improve the performance of advanced metrology systems. Your work will focus on implementing sophisticated machine and algorithm functionality.

You will work closely with software engineers and multidisciplinary stakeholders to deliver high-quality, production-ready functionality. You will also collaborate with Customer Support and Manufacturing teams to ensure smooth integration and practical usability.

Your responsibilities will cover the full software development lifecycle, including:

Refining requirements and user stories
Designing software solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs
Planning and estimating development work
Defining and executing test strategies
Developing and maintaining software
Supporting CI/CD pipelines
Troubleshooting technical issues
Preparing software releases
Communicating progress and technical decisions

You will demonstrate strong Java and/or C# engineering practices and contribute to team discussions and design decisions.

Main responsibilities

Take end-to-end ownership of feature and story-based software development, from refinement through delivery.
Align specifications with relevant stakeholders to establish shared understanding and technical consistency.
Safeguard software and product quality through robust engineering practices and peer reviews.
Deliver high-quality software through disciplined design, thorough testing, and clear, maintainable documentation.
Share technical knowledge with colleagues and customer-facing teams to support successful integration and operation.

Education and experience

A master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, informatics, or a related technical field.
At least five years of professional experience developing technical, object-oriented software solutions using Java and/or C#.
Experience working in a high-tech, algorithm-driven, or complex systems environment is preferred.
Strong knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to create robust, scalable, and maintainable software.
Practical experience with Test-Driven Development and automated testing.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills, with the ability to translate advanced algorithms into production-ready software.
Experience with image processing or numerical algorithms is preferred.
Experience with Python or React is an advantage.
Willingness to work with different technologies, including Java, C#, Python, and React, depending on project needs.
Experience with large-scale data processing, data-storage design, or query-performance optimization is an advantage.

Skills

To thrive in this role, you:

Work effectively as part of a collaborative and multidisciplinary team.
Are comfortable in a dynamic, high-tech product-development environment.
Combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and flexible approach to problem-solving.
Take ownership and remain accountable for results.
Focus on business and customer value and prioritize work effectively.
Are curious, learn quickly, and apply new knowledge effectively.
Communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English.

Other information

ASML is a leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, enabling the production of integrated circuits and microchips. Our software engineers play an important role in optimizing semiconductor manufacturing processes and improving quality and efficiency.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of advanced metrology solutions that help customers improve process control, accelerate production ramp-up, and optimize output.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.
